body.message:
Good Afternoon Simone,

As we recall, you had sent us back AED 1,000. We would like to kindly remind you that during your initial check-in, due to the apartment charges, we had offered you a refund of AED 1,000, which is the amount we will be processing back to you.

For your reference, we have attached the previous email regarding this matter.

Could you please share your bank details so we can proceed with the refund process?

In total, you should receive:

AED 1,000 refundable security deposit
AED 1,000 apartment charge refund

Total refund amount: AED 2,000

Thank you.
body.contact_name: Simone Pravin Chhabda Pravin Kishan Chhabda
